weights)</div><div>Logits -&gt; `z_t = \hat{W}h_t`</div><div>Output -&gt; `P(y_t|h_t)` = `\text{softmax}(z_t)` (Probability of output `y_t` given `h_t`)</div><div>Learning Objective -&gt;
